summary: Full backend + frontend regression on AI Interview Engine focused on: batch evaluation endpoint, Whisper STT endpoint, fixed cheating-analysis endpoint, purple/pink Dashboard theme, and end-to-end interview flow ensuring per-question evaluation is no longer triggered. All 8 backend pytest cases passed (24.61s) and the full UI flow (analyze -> setup-bypassed via API -> interview -> results) completed successfully with the correct batch-evaluation behavior.

issues: Header band is solid dark navy while every other page uses the purple/pink gradient theme - visual inconsistency with the new Dashboard theme. Consider applying the same from-slate-900 via-purple-900 gradient for cohesion.

action_items: Optional: Align Results page header with the new purple/pink gradient theme used in Dashboard and Interview pages.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py exposes legacy POST /api/evaluate-answer (per-question) alongside the new batch endpoint. Frontend no longer calls it, but leaving it active is a footgun for future regressions. Consider removing it or marking deprecated.
/api/transcribe-audio writes uploads to /tmp using uuid filenames - good. However, on failure path before tmp_path.unlink, the file may leak. Wrap in try/finally to always clean up.

save-cheating-analysis stores cheating_events and then mutates the same dict to pop _id before returning - acceptable, but the upstream Mongo insert mutates the passed dict by injecting _id (Motor behavior). Currently handled correctly with analysis.pop('_id', None).
evaluate-interview-batch fully replaces session.answers on each call ($set). If user re-submits accidentally, prior answers are wiped. Consider idempotency guard or merge strategy.

Frontend InterviewRoomWithVideo.jsx: handleVisibilityChange uses stale cheatingWarnings from closure (functional setState not used for the side-effect comparison). Could double-warn under fast tab switches; recommend setCheatingWarnings(prev => ...) and deriving newWarningCount from prev.
seed_data_creation: Created a TEST_Backend_Engineer interview session (id captured per run); plus 1 live session 'Senior Backend Engineer' (aae2ac29-...) via UI walk-through. Both safe to leave (no PII).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_interview_engine.py covers: root health, batch eval (404 + happy path + persistence), transcribe-audio (400 on empty / 422 on missing), save-cheating-analysis (success + risk_level mapping + 422), analytics/history. Run with: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<frontend-url> pytest /app/backend/tests/test_interview_engine.py -v. Frontend critical assertions to preserve: 0 calls to /api/evaluate-answer during interview, exactly 1 /api/evaluate-interview-batch on final submit, redirect to /results/<sessionId>. data-testids in use: dashboard-page, mic-record-btn, next-question-btn, answer-input, analyze-btn, resume-text-input, job-description-input.
rca of the issue: N/A - no bugs reproduced this iteration. Previous fork's per-question /api/evaluate-answer 404 cascade is now fully eliminated: confirmed via network trace that the new InterviewRoomWithVideo.jsx only fires /api/evaluate-interview-batch once at submit. Previous 422 on /api/save-cheating-analysis (form-encoded mismatch) is also fixed by the new Pydantic CheatingAnalysisRequest body model.
